slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: Costa Rica's Pacific coast where rainforest meets the sea, signalling a luxury, nature-led wedding ahead of a practical legal guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 16:9, at least 2000px wide. A Pacific coastline or rainforest-edge setting in Costa Rica (for example Guanacaste or the central Pacific): an elegant, understated ceremony set-up (arch or aisle, natural florals) on a headland lawn or beach edge with tropical forest behind and ocean beyond, golden hour, dry-season light. No people needed; a distant consented couple is acceptable. No venue named in copy or caption until 03-source-pack confirms one. Location proven by media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest or officiant consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. Source order: venue or resort media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent); Instituto Costarricense de Turismo (ICT) media only if its licence covers third-party commercial blog use ([[VERIFY licence]], record terms, credit and expiry in library-index.csv); licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image.
